name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 80 – Am 52
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 80a. Condemns the July 2026 mass crossing into Ceuta as a hybrid attack against Spain and the EU’s external border; calls for a full investigation into its coordination through social media and any involvement by third-country authorities, and for solidarity with Spain in securing the EU’s external border;
